LLM-RB.description: Felzenszwalb graph segmentation on the first three PCs defines regions, an RBF SVM classifies pixels from their PCs plus Gaussian-smoothed PCs at two scales, and each region takes the majority vote of its pixels.

LLM-MRG.description: Baseline MRG growth rule unchanged; regions described by PC mean and std, mean V, mean spectrum and two-scale smoothed-PC context, labelled by an RBF SVM.

Baseline MRG.description: Modified region growing on the PCA V channel with histogram-frequency seeds, intensity and orientation constraints to the seed inside a 3x3 grid; regions described by 88 GLCM features and their mean spectrum.
